verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party benchmark page, published tokens-per-second table, or load-testing guide. The only concrete number is an informal vendor-side HN comment that a coding draft model has "break[ed] 300 tok/s". Prometheus latency and token metrics for dedicated endpoints, plus TTFT optimization docs, let engineers measure speed themselves, and community users widely report very high speed, but none of this is a published benchmark. Missing for 10: official published TPS/latency benchmarks per model, independent third-party benchmark results, a load-testing or benchmarking methodology guide, and latency numbers for public shared endpoints.
